name: dots-brain
description: Install and operate a personal, source-aware memory service on your own host.

interface.shortDescription: One memory for your AI tools
interface.longDescription: Set up and verify the Dots Brain alpha on a supported local host. Remote OAuth, automatic conversation capture, native views, and MCP Events are not yet implemented.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Dots Brain on my memory host and verify the available capabilities.
